19d63a532c.headline: Rabobank returns as title sponsor of Visma-Lease a Bike Women
19d63a532c.full_caption:
Rabobank is back as a title sponsor after a 10-year absence.

From 2027 the women's team will be known as Rabobank-Lease a Bike Women's Pro Cycling Team. Visma has stepped down as naming sponsor, and no new title sponsor has been announced for the men's squad. The two teams will carry different names for the first time since the women's team launched in 2021.

Will the Rabobank name look right on Marianne Vos and Pauline Ferrand-Prévot again?

Source: Cyclingnews

#cycling #procycling #womenscycling #roadcycling #WorldTour #Rabobank #VismaLeaseABike #MarianneVos #PaulineFerrandPrevot #cyclingnews
19d63a532c.alt_text: Graphic announcing that Rabobank will return as title sponsor of the Visma-Lease a Bike women's cycling team from 2027.

slides.title: Rabobank is back
slides.text: Visma-Lease a Bike have named Rabobank as title sponsor of their women's team. From 2027 it will be called Rabobank-Lease a Bike Women's Pro Cycling Team.

slides.title: Two teams, two names
slides.text: Visma has officially stepped down as title sponsor. The announcement covers only the women's team, so the men's title sponsor is still unknown. The two squads will have different names for the first time since 2021.

slides.title: A return after 10 years
slides.text: Rabobank left men's cycling at the end of 2012, after a long sponsorship of this team. It has been investing in the sport again in recent years, and this is a significant step back towards its former prominence.

slides.title: Familiar faces, familiar name
slides.text: Marianne Vos and Pauline Ferrand-Prévot both rode for the old Rabobank women's team between 2012 and 2016. They will wear Rabobank jerseys again.

d13729415c.headline: E3 Saxo Classic gets easier, Dwars door Vlaanderen tougher for 2027
d13729415c.full_caption:
Two of the big cobbled Classics have new routes for 2027, and they move in opposite directions. 🚴

The E3 Saxo Classic drops from 16 climbs to 14 after a request from the peloton. Dwars door Vlaanderen goes the other way, rising from 12 climbs to 16 for the men. Both races fall in the week before the Tour of Flanders.

Which change will shape the racing more?

Source: Cyclingnews

#cycling #procycling #roadcycling #WorldTour #E3SaxoClassic #DwarsdoorVlaanderen #CobbledClassics #Classics #Flanders #WomensCycling
d13729415c.alt_text: News graphic announcing the revised 2027 routes for the E3 Saxo Classic and Dwars door Vlaanderen cobbled Classics.

slides.title: E3 Saxo Classic: slightly shorter
slides.text: The 70th edition is on March 26, 2027. Distance falls from 208.8km to 207.8km and climbs from 16 to 14, after a request from the peloton to reduce the elevation gain.

slides.title: What goes and what stays
slides.text: The Berg Ten Stene and Oude Kruisberg are cut. The Oude Kwaremont twice, Taaienberg, Eikenberg, Paterberg and Tiegemberg stay, along with nine cobbled sectors. Start and finish remain in Harelbeke.

slides.title: Dwars door Vlaanderen: tougher
slides.text: The 81st men's race is on March 31, 2027, over 185km from Roeselare to Waregem. It has 16 climbs, up from 12. The Kluisberg replaces the Volkegemberg, and the Knokteberg-Trieu, Hotond and Berg Ten Houte are each climbed three times.

slides.title: Women's race also gets harder
slides.text: The 15th women's edition covers 130km from and to Waregem, with 11 climbs (up from eight) and six cobbled sections. The final 72km match the men's race.

13f319b430.headline: Uno-X Mobility part ways with 10 riders and staff for 2027
13f319b430.full_caption:
Uno-X Mobility are saying goodbye to 10 riders and staff members ahead of 2027.

The departures come after the team took stage wins at all three Grand Tours, a milestone for the Norwegian-registered squad. The reshuffle sets up the roster and staff the team will carry into the next season.

Which departure will the team miss most, and what should Uno-X prioritise in the transfer market?

ceec131ace.headline: Netcompany Ineos end Tejada deal after ITA passport charge
ceec131ace.full_caption:
Netcompany Ineos and Harold Tejada have ended their 2027 agreement before he was due to join on January 1.

The ITA has charged the Colombian with an anti-doping rule violation over unexplained abnormalities in his biological passport, and a mandatory provisional suspension is in place. Tejada maintains his innocence and says the suspension is neither a sanction nor a final decision.

Should teams wait for the process to finish before acting on a case like this?

Source: Cyclingnews

#cycling #procycling #roadcycling #WorldTour #NetcompanIneos #HaroldTejada #antidoping #UCI #cyclingnews #ITA
ceec131ace.alt_text: News graphic reading that Netcompany Ineos have ended their 2027 agreement with Colombian rider Harold Tejada following an ITA anti-doping charge.

slides.title: Deal terminated before it began
slides.text: Netcompany Ineos and Harold Tejada agreed to end their agreement for 2027. He was due to join the team on January 1. The team announced it on X.

slides.title: The ITA charge
slides.text: The ITA charged Tejada with an anti-doping rule violation based on unexplained abnormalities in his athlete biological passport. A mandatory provisional suspension has been imposed.

slides.title: Tejada's response
slides.text: Tejada says he was notified on November 26, 2026. He calls the suspension a temporary measure, not a sanction or final decision, and says his legal and medical team will handle his defence.

slides.title: What happens next
slides.text: The rider can accept the consequences or ask for a hearing at the UCI Anti-Doping Tribunal. He can also challenge the provisional suspension. Ineos announced his signing less than 50 days earlier.

860bbb76b2.headline: Schreiber wins snowy World Cup opener in Ostrava
860bbb76b2.full_caption:
Marie Schreiber wins the first UCI Cyclo-cross World Cup round of the season in Ostrava. ❄️

The SD Worx-Protime rider took a solo victory on a snow-covered course and moves into the overall World Cup lead. Aniek van Alphen was second and Manon Bakker third. It is a strong response after Schreiber's relegation at the European Championships.

Who impressed you most in the Ostrava snow?

Source: Cyclingnews

#cyclocross #UCICyclocross #CXWorldCup #Ostrava #MarieSchreiber #SDWorx #WomensCycling #cycling #cyclingnews #proCycling
860bbb76b2.alt_text: Graphic announcing Marie Schreiber's win in the opening women's elite UCI Cyclo-cross World Cup round in snowy Ostrava, Czech Republic.

slides.title: Schreiber wins solo in Ostrava
slides.text: Marie Schreiber (SD Worx-Protime) won the opening UCI Cyclo-cross World Cup round in Ostrava. Aniek van Alphen (777 CX Team) took second and Manon Bakker third.

slides.title: How the race unfolded
slides.text: Van Alphen led early and held an eight-second gap on lap four of seven. She was caught with under two laps left, and Bakker then joined her and Schreiber. Schreiber made her winning move on the last lap.

slides.title: Bad luck for the favourites
slides.text: Ceylin del Carmen Alvarado crashed but finished fifth, behind fourth-placed Zoe Bäckstedt. World champion Lucinda Brand had pedal problems, needed a bike change and finished 15th, 2:25 down.

slides.title: New World Cup leader
slides.text: Schreiber takes the series lead after the first round. She said clipping in was difficult for everyone early on, and that she improved after changing bikes.

1777c9bdf5.headline: Van Aert reportedly set for cyclocross return on 19 December
1777c9bdf5.full_caption:
Wout van Aert is lining up a return to cyclocross, and a run at the world title looks increasingly likely.

Het Laatste Nieuws reports the Visma-Lease a Bike rider will start his 2026-27 winter in Antwerp on 19 December. The Worlds in Ostend on 31 January 2027 now look like a probable target.

Will Van Aert get back in the rainbow jersey? 🌈

Source: Cyclingnews

#cycling #cyclocross #WoutVanAert #VanAert #VismaLeaseABike #CXWorlds #Ostend #cyclingnews #veldrijden #MathieuVanDerPoel
1777c9bdf5.alt_text: News graphic with the headline that Wout van Aert is reportedly set to return to cyclocross on 19 December in Antwerp.

slides.title: Return date reported
slides.text: Het Laatste Nieuws says Van Aert will open his 2026-27 cyclocross season on 19 December in Antwerp. He started last winter there too and finished 7th.

slides.title: A bigger winter programme
slides.text: He may race around 12 times, double last winter's six. An ankle fracture in Mol in early January ended his 2025-26 season early, and he went without a win for the first time since 2010.

slides.title: Worlds in Ostend on the cards
slides.text: The Worlds in Ostend on 31 January 2027 now look increasingly likely to be on his schedule. His race programme is not yet finalised, and Belgian coach Angelo De Clercq had earlier suggested his participation was uncertain.

slides.title: History with the rainbow jersey
slides.text: Van Aert won three straight world titles from 2016 to 2018. His last three attempts to add another all ended in second place behind Mathieu van der Poel, including Ostend in 2021.

fa877a50fd.headline: Ferrand-Prévot to race as Pauline van Baarle from 2027
fa877a50fd.full_caption:
Pauline Ferrand-Prévot is changing her professional name.

The Visma-Lease a Bike rider says she wants to be known as Pauline van Baarle from 2027, taking the surname of her husband Dylan, whom she married in October. She told Dutch broadcaster NOS about the change at an event announcing her team's new sponsor structure. She acknowledged the name may not be easy for everyone to pronounce, but said it matters a great deal to both her and Dylan, and that she will be "a little more Dutch" next year.

Will you be ready to say van Baarle on the start line next season? 🇳🇱

Source: Escape Collective
